title: Expert gaze as a usability indicator of medical AI decision support systems: a preliminary study.
summary: Dentists could toggle an AI caries detector while examining bitewings; eye tracking found AI use on roughly one quarter of inspection time and increased attention to interface elements.
ai_technology: The AI caries-detection support was the study intervention; eye tracking measured expert interaction with its optional output.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Dentists could toggle an AI caries detector while examining bitewings; eye tracking found AI use on roughly one quarter of inspection time and increased attention to interface elements.
evidence.unknown: This preliminary dentist usability study measured gaze and interface attention, not diagnostic accuracy or patient outcomes.
